# Mass LinkedIn Company Scraper

> Upload a large file of LinkedIn company URLs. The run is resumable, up to 1,000,000 URLs, and each row is the company record.

Mawsool publishes this as an Apify Actor. Starting from $0.90 per 1,000 companies.

## Run

- Apify Actor: https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-mass-linkedin-company-scraper
- Call: `oday/mawsool-mass-linkedin-company-scraper`
- API key: https://mawsool.tech/ and https://docs.mawsool.tech/
- Contact: osama@mawsool.tech, info@mawsool.tech

## Use it when

The company file is too large for a small run.

## Use something else when

You have a few company URLs and you want one detailed record. Use LinkedIn Company Details.

## Page

- Scrape LinkedIn companies in bulk: docs/bulk-linkedin-company-scraper.md

Mawsool is not affiliated with LinkedIn.
